prime_award_base_transaction_description: THIS STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) DESCRIBES AND SPECIFIES A CONTRACTOR EFFORT REQUIRED TO PERFORM  PREPARATION, LOGISTICS, INTERIM CONTRACTOR SUPPORT AND OPTION FOR ENGINEERING SERVICES OF AN MOTS ENGINEERING DEVELOPMENT MODEL (EDM) (HENCEFORTH REFERRED TO AS EDM1 AND EDM2) AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL (ATC) TOWER GROUP THAT WILL BE FIELDED TO AN ARMY ATC UNIT.  THE SOW ADDRESSES HARDWARE PREPARATION UTILIZING COMPONENTS FROM THE TWO MOTS EDMS TO EXPEDITE PREPARATION OF A SINGLE MOTS ATC TOWER GROUP EDM CAPABLE OF DEPLOYMENT TO THEATRE.  EDM2 WILL BE UTILIZED TO RECONFIGURE, SUPPORT AND DEPLOY EDM1.  THIS SOW ADDRESSES INITIAL ISSUE SPARES AND INTERIM CONTRACTOR SUPPORT SPARES HARDWARE TO SUPPORT UNIT TRAINING AND DEPLOYMENT OF A SINGLE MOTS ATC TOWER GROUP EDM FOR A PERIOD OF 18 MONTHS.  THIS SOW ADDRESSES LOGISTIC MATERIAL UPDATES.  THIS SOW ADDRESSES 6 MONTHS OF CONUS AND 12 MONTHS OF IN-THEATER CONTRACTOR FIELD SERVICE SUPPORT.  THE CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR PROVIDING ALL MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT, FACILITIES, HARDWARE/SOFTWARE (EXCEPT GOVERNMENT FURNISHED EQUIPMENT (GFE) LISTED IN THE CONTRACT), TECHNICAL, PLANNING, MANAGEMENT, MANUFACTURING, AND SHIPPING EFFORTS REQUIRED TO MANAGE THIS CONTRACT.  1.1 BACKGROUND  TWO MOTS EDMS (EDM1 AND EDM2) WERE DESIGNED AND FABRICATED DURING THE SYSTEM DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT (SDD) PHASE OF THE MOTS ACQUISITION CYCLE.  THE TWO EDMS WERE SUBJECTED TO DEVELOPMENTAL AND OPERATIONAL TESTING THAT EXPOSED THE MOTS TO TESTS THAT REPLICATED THE EFFECTS OF ENVIRONMENTS ON THE EQUIPMENT AND THE CONDITIONS THAT MOTS WILL EXPERIENCE THROUGHOUT ITS SERVICE LIFE.  THE MOTS EDM1 WAS UPDATED UNDER AN SDD EXTENSION CONTRACT FOR SEVERAL PRODUCTION CONFIGURATION IMPROVEMENTS.
